title: Mapping libraries over published content
description: A library maps published content to hand-written classes through attributes or conventions, usually with generic As<T>() calls.

impact.summary: A mapping library needs a release for the target generation, or a replacement.

handling.option: Use generated models and map by hand where a view model is needed
handling.when: No maintained release of the library supports the target

sources.evidence: The mode is indicated by the Umbraco:CMS:ModelsBuilder:ModelsMode key in the configuration

handling.option: Keep a mapping library that has a release for the target (checked through package metadata)
handling.when: Package metadata shows a release for the target

checks.text: Every view model built by the library has the same values before and after (spot-check pages)
